questions.subtopic: Expectations from Democracy as an Indicator
questions.question: When citizens express dissatisfaction that public hospitals and government schools are not functioning adequately, this demonstrates that:
options: Citizens have developed high democratic consciousness and hold the state accountable for public welfare delivery
Citizens want to replace democracy with a military dictatorship immediately
The country should permanently abolish public healthcare and education
Elections have failed completely and should be canceled
questions.explanation: The fact that people are complaining is itself a testimony to the success of democracy: it shows that people have developed awareness and the ability to expect and to look critically at power holders and the high and the mighty.

questions.question: Which of the following is an undeniable structural defect inherent in non-democratic regimes?
options: They spend too much time debating legislation in public assemblies
They are compelled to publish all financial transactions on public websites
They give supreme veto rights to independent trade unions
The rulers are not accountable to the citizens, and there are no institutional mechanisms to change them peacefully if they turn tyrannical
questions.explanation: Non-democratic rulers do not have to face elections or parliamentary questioning; citizens have no legal mechanism to demand transparency or remove despotic rulers peacefully.

questions.question: Which statement best captures the realistic assessment of democratic outcomes according to the NCERT curriculum?
options: Democracy guarantees that every family will receive identical income regardless of effort
Democracy has proved worse than military rule in protecting fundamental human liberties
Democracy is not a magical cure for all ills, but it provides the most just, transparent, and dignified institutional framework for human self-governance
Democracy functions perfectly without any citizen participation or vigilance
questions.explanation: Democracy is not a magical solution to all economic and social woes, but it is demonstrably better than any alternative because it respects human dignity, resolves conflicts peacefully, and ensures rulers remain answerable to the governed.
